result.detail: Design choices. The testbench uses a reference model built from the spec, plus constants worked out by hand, so a check cannot pass by copying the DUT's own output. Priority is always tested with several requesters pending. Same-edge set/clear interactions are tested for both trigger modes. Inputs change only at negedge, and reads happen in the first 5 ns after a posedge on a 100 ns clock, which avoids races. The model is updated in its own posedge block, so it stays aligned with the DUT even if a cycle is lost. Residual risks: (1) the plusarg name; (2) Icarus support for string; (3) no mutant run has been done, though the knowledge doc recommends one to confirm the checks can fail. The review_record evidence requirement is for an independent reviewer; I cannot provide it for my own work. No tool run is listed because no run ID is on the citation list.
